title: Relative open comparison identifies with the literal single-module comparison
statement: Let p:Y→B, g:A→B be arbitrary scheme morphisms, W,Z opens of Y with Z≤W, and N an O_W-module [def-pc-module-pullback]. Use standard derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Put f=W.ι;p, X′=W×_B A, g′=pullback.fst f g, f′=pullback.snd f g, K=N[0], K′=(g′ tensor-pullback N)[0], and φ=picardTermwiseSingleMap(g′,N) [lem-sc-picard-termwise-single-map-composition]. The relative arrow relativeMVLocalArrow f f′ g g′ at the open W.ι inverse image Z [def-pc-relative-mv-maps] is isomorphic in the arrow category to standardSingleBaseChangeMap (Z.ι;p) ((Y.homOfLE hZ) tensor-pullback N) g [def-pc-standard-single-base-change-map]. Both vertex comparisons are invertible; neither comparison arrow is asserted invertible.

proof.text: Identify the open scheme of W.ι inverse image Z with Z using Scheme.Opens.isoOfLE. Its map to W is homOfLE hZ. Use the projection-preserving isomorphism between the corresponding cartesian pullbacks and exact open restriction of single complexes. These produce the two vertex isomorphisms.

Expand the relative coefficient map and the standard comparison. Apply picardTermwiseSingleMap_composition to the two routes around the open square; the tensor composition comparisons identify their literal coefficient modules. Use exists_derivedBaseChange_source_iso for the source coordinates. Expand the adjunction units and counits and use the composite-adjunction counit formula to equate the coefficient mates; this calculation must be carried out here rather than importing the cyclic open-coefficient transport module. The resulting commuting square is an arrow isomorphism. Empty Z, Z=W, and zero N use the same exact-restriction isomorphisms.

theorem standardSingle_open_relative_arrow
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) (g : A ⟶ B)
    (W Z : Y.Opens) (hZ : Z ≤ W) (N : W.toScheme.Modules) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    let f := W.ι ≫ p
    let K := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj N
    let K' := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback f g).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst f g) N)
    Nonempty
      (relativeMVLocalArrow f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
          (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g) K K'
          (Scheme.picardTermwiseSingleMap (pullback.fst f g) N) (W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ Z) ≅
        Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap (Z.ι ≫ p)
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE hZ) N) g))
